title: Pistachio Dumplings with Sweet Filling
description: A traditional dessert from the Middle East, these sweet dumplings are wrapped in a crispy pistachio crust and served with a warm sweet syrup.

ingredients.name: pistachio meal
ingredients.notes: you can make your own by grinding pistachios in a food processor

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: you can adjust the amount according to your taste

ingredients.name: sweet syrup
ingredients.notes: you can make your own by boiling sugar and water

instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Add the dumplings and fry until golden brown on both sides.
In a separate pan, heat the sweet syrup over low heat.
Add the sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add the pistachio meal and stir until combined.
Wrap each dumpling in a piece of dough, making sure to seal the edges.
Fry the dumplings in the oil until golden brown on both sides.
Drain the dumplings on paper towels.
Serve the dumplings warm with the sweet syrup.
Garnish with chopped pistachios and a sprinkle of sugar.
